description: Find a website's RSS/Atom/JSON feeds and read the latest items: parses <link rel="alternate"> tags, likely feed links and (if none) probes common feed paths, then parses the feed (RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0/RDF, Atom 1.0, JSON Feed) into clean JSON items with title, link, published date (ISO), author, summary, categories and enclosure. Also accepts a feed URL directly. SSRF-safe fetches. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/feed-discover

items.description: Latest items to return 0-50 (default 10; 0 = discovery only)

probe.description: Probe common feed paths when the page declares none (default true)

url.description: Site URL or feed URL (http/https, public hosts only)

name: feed_discover
title: Feed Discover
